positive_snippets: Stayed here recently and overall had a pleasant experience. The hotel’s location in Sector 27 is super convenient — close to shopping, metro, and restaurants, which made getting around Noida easy. Rooms were comfortable and the staff were polite and helpful throughout our stay. The breakfast was nice and the restaurant served good food. While some areas feel a bit dated and could use some renovation, it didn’t take away from a comfortable stay. Good choice if you’re looking for a well-located and affordable hotel in Noida

negative_snippets:
Very Poor Experience at PK Residency

I stayed at PK Residency, and my experience was extremely disappointing.

The lift was not working, and there was no prior information about it.

The staff was unprofessional and uncooperative, and proper service was not provided.

Cleanliness was very poor throughout the property.

The breakfast buffet was completely cold, and there was no staff available to assist or even take feedback.

When we ordered food, the staff inside the kitchen were arguing among themselves about who would prepare the order, which was very uncomfortable and unprofessional to witness.
And worst thing is that if someone is giving genuine review they are blaiming to the reviewer.

Overall, this hotel fails to meet even basic hospitality standards. I do not recommend this place to anyone and suggest management take immediate corrective
